webOnly.src/lib/decodedTiles.ts: the web's byte-bounded store of decoded tiles shared by its loaders; RadarTileStore and RadarCompositor keep the native map's
webOnly.src/lib/packPixels.ts: packs value bytes into WebGL textures
webOnly.src/lib/gpuBudget.ts: WebGL, decode and preview budgets by device class; the native caches have their own bounds
webOnly.src/lib/gpuTiles.ts: the WebGL frame layer's texture cache; the native map keeps put-together pictures in RadarCompositor
webOnly.src/layers/radarDrawing.ts: chooses between the web's WebGL frame layer and its tile layers

unported.src/layers/radarFrames.ts: the WebGL2 frame layer. Its switching whole, same-step stand-ins, rest and previews are ported (RadarEngine, RadarOverlay, lib/frameSwitch.ts, lib/previewTiles.ts); its crossfade in value across a step's 450 ms (radarCrossfade, CROSSFADE_MS) is not: the native map colours tiles before putting a step together, and MapKit's tile-by-tile overlay redraws cannot dissolve every animation frame without a GPU renderer
